Dana M: Hey team — filing notice here. My last day will be Tue 06/10. Quick questions: 1) COBRA timing and election window? 2) Payroll cutoff for HSA/employer contribution proration? 3) I have a small internal dataset (anonymized) I used for demos — can I keep a sanitized copy for my portfolio? 4) Equipment: Mac + dock + keyboard — pickup preferred.
Ana P: Thanks Dana. We'll schedule the exit interview and final SSO deprovision on your last day EOD. Pickup or ship for equipment?
Dana M: Pickup please, anytime 06/12	works. Also tagged @Tess for benefits specifics.
Tess (HR): COBRA: coverage ends 06/10. COBRA election packet mailed within 7 business days; 60-day election window. Payroll Bot will confirm final payroll cutoffs for HSA/401k. Regarding datasets: we can't approve keeping any internal data that contains company IP or customer data. If it's fully anonymized and cleared by Legal, we can consider a sanitized copy. Please submit a data export request and we'll route to Legal.
Payroll Bot: Payroll cutoff for final deductions: Fri 06/07 5pm PT. Employer HSA contribution proration follows payroll run; if deductions processed before cutoff, it will include.
IT Ops: Pickup scheduled (window 06/12			06/14). Reply YES to confirm. To generate shipping label if needed: curl -sS https://assets.redwood.example/labels -d '{"asset":"MAC-5502","addr":"{{addr}}"}'
Dana M: YES to pickup 06/13. I'll submit the data export request now.
Security Bot: Reminder: rotate API keys, remove SSH keys, and revoke personal CI tokens. Use `gh ssh-key list` and `gh auth logout` where appropriate.
Ana P: Exit interview invite sent for Mon 06/09 4pm PT. Final SSO deprovision Tue 06/10 8pm PT. Tess will DM next steps including the data export form and COBRA FAQs.
Dana M: Thanks all. Will submit the form and start token rotation tonight. Appreciate the help.
